rows.grounds: locative compound indicating the region associated with Nāgara and Āḍīśa
name of the sage placed in this region
indicates placement in the same manner as previously stated

items.question: In which directional region is Agastya likewise to be situated?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe specific placements and orientations for figures.
This verse names Agastya as the figure to be placed.
The term tathaiva indicates that Agastya's placement follows the same manner as before.
items.inference: Agastya should likewise be situated in the Nāgara-Āḍīśa region.
uncertainties: The precise directional identification of the Nāgara-Āḍīśa region depends on the ritual layout assumed in context.
items.plain_english: And Agastya should likewise be placed in the region of Nāgara and Āḍīśa.
